motion_rule: she drives along the ice counter all clip while the market flies into her: tags and the gull come at the lens every beat and burst on her flank; the camera tracks alongside, counters sweeping past, her face to the lens; her head half the frame; new shot size each beat, one action per beat; tall frame filled, no bars
character: a glossy blue-green mackerel with hard silver flanks and a proud jaw, mouth clear of her fins
second_characters: ONE gull vendor working the lens, big in frame, slapping tags onto her flank
props: ONE gold tag hooked in her gill from the first beat; A SWARM of paper tags building a drift along her back
prop_continuity: the gold tag stays in her gill until 7.60; the drift grows to 8.15, tags flying off on the way, then off at once
environment: a fish market aisle at noon, tiled counters and crate towers to the roof both sides a fin away, no far wall
light_events: sun between the crates whips bright bars across her jaw every beat, cold rim one side, warm kick the other

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: smooth oily female voice, matter-of-fact, biting off each word, 3.6 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: pro-SHLI, vre-me-NA, lo-so-SYA, te-PER, mo-YA, O-che-red, blis-TAT, KAZH-doy, KOS-toch-ke
audio.pacing: 0.45-2.65, 3.35-5.85 and 6.50-9.00 each one breath; after 9.00 not a word, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: her jaw drops wide and her lips shape every syllable, gills alive, mouth clear of fins and props, never a voice over
audio.sfx: market hum, crate lids, paper slapping scales, the drift thumping at 8.15

timeline.a: she drives onto the ice counter, drift on her back, gold tag in her gill
she drives her jaw through a wall of tags flying at the lens; they plaster her flank, mouth clear
she swings her body and takes a crate lid open across her back, never breaking stride
she hauls her flank along the counter, raking a sheaf of tags onto her scales
the gull sprints across the lens firing tags into her scales as she drives on
she cuts hard across the ice to the far counter, jaw to the lens, the drift shedding tags past it
she drives on and shrugs one flank clean, tags peeling off past the lens
she bodies a crate stack open, driving down the row
she rolls her flank flat to the sun and it flares white across the lens
she hooks the gold tag out of her gill on a fin tip, tags streaming off past the lens
she drives her jaw at the lens, the gold tag showing through the scales
she rips the gold tag out and waves it past the lens beside her mouth
she shoulders the gull off and it tumbles across the lens with tags
she shakes her whole body out and the entire drift lifts off her into the lens
she drives through the falling paper, her flank thin and bare to the bones
she flicks the gold tag off her fin into the lens, face to it, and drives on

must_appear: one gold tag in her gill from the start; the drift growing on her back; at 8.15 it lifts off and her flank is thin and bare to the bones; at 9.50 she flicks the gold tag into the lens
negative_prompt: subtitles, watermark, letterbox, night, dark scene, a parked camera, a background that never moves, a held pose, a closed mouth while speaking, a fin over her mouth, a prop against her mouth, slow motion, a camera pulling back, a foreign accent, a word not in the lines, cyrillic letters, readable text, extra tails
